choices.why: The brown wood-effect open bookcase echoes the floor's wood tone and holds far more books than a single shelf, which suits the bare white left wall.
Its dark brown bentwood frame matches the floor, and the cognac leather gives the warm, cozy reading spot the user asked for.
It is the only round rug, and its soft beige pile softens the dark floor and the concrete ceiling.
The swing arm puts light right over the armchair, and the fabric drum shade gives a warmer, softer glow than bare metal shades.
The organic-shaped walnut nesting tables repeat the floor's wood tone and are compact beside the chair.
The beige linen filters light softly and warms the black window frames without darkening the room.

answer.why: Medium and dark brown woods, cognac leather and beige textiles create a warm, cohesive palette that picks up the floor's wood tone. Together they soften the industrial concrete and turn the window corner into a cozy reading nook.
